toxic reminders for when
you want to skip studying today

"i'll do double tomorrow"
you said that yesterday. tomorrow-you is ALREADY tired.

you don't have to feel like it.
you have to sit down. the rest follows.

just 10 minutes of testing yourself.
if you still want to stop after that, fine. you WON'T.

skipping today is easy.
explaining the grade in 3 weeks is NOT.

you have time to watch other people study on your phone
but not time to study? interesting.

the girl you want to be next semester
is built on boring days like THIS one.
open the notes. that's the whole task right now. GO.
